swayable.summary: A person reacts to a TikTok video of a dad doing something impressive, calling it the best TikTok ever and suggesting they redo it. The tone is casual, enthusiastic, and brief with no policy content.
swayable.title: Dad of the Year: The TikTok That Got It Right

traits.change: Add a line like 'As a veteran, I know what real commitment looks like' to establish the messenger as a veteran.
Add a line contrasting bad parenting with this dad's example, such as 'Most parents scroll past — this dad showed up.'
The script reads as a casual phone recording; refilm with professional lighting, sound, and editing to raise production value.
